Featuring a dramatic double-height ceiling, a European-inspired kitchen, and a welcoming exterior, the project was thoughtfully designed and executed end-to-end by Storywalls Architects, covering every detail of the interiors and exteriors to create a cohesive, sophisticated living experience.

data.projects.3.brief: Transforming spaces is an art. Delivering them seamlessly, right on schedule, is our commitment. This Pune renovation project reflects our commitment to thoughtful design, precise execution, and quality craftsmanship. Through meticulous planning and efficient coordination, we transformed the space into a refined, functional interior while ensuring a hassle-free process and timely handover.
